title: 12A — Overhead / corrected train direction

There must be no second nose at the bottom. Keep its graphite body, cyan roof-edge trim and gold cockpit detailing. Maintain its physical width and lane placement.

Riley remains in her left separated lane, around x=0.34, with head/leading hand around y=0.52 and trailing boot around y=0.67, so she starts BEHIND the upward-facing nose by about one projected body length. Show her back and crown, not her frontal face. Keep her current believable size. Exactly one Riley, one train. No typography. One corrected START frame, not collage. The train direction and behind-the-nose starting position are the only changes.
